records.text: Recovery Recon writes: "Is it not weird that within minutes the FBI posted pics of the ammo with 'anti-ICE' from today and showed us pics of the windows with the holes in them, referring to the shooting in the ICE facility in Dallas?"
records.speaker: Candace Owens
